page_faq_data.question: Where is the ceremony and reception, and what time should I arrive?
page_faq_data.answer: Ceremony: St. Augustine Parish Church Reception: Casa Lucido Events Place The ceremony starts exactly at 10:00 AM. Please arrive before 9:30 AM to allow enough time for parking, finding your seat, and getting settled before the ceremony. Please visit the Wedding page for more details. Click here to view.

page_faq_data.question: What is RSVP, and do I need to RSVP?
page_faq_data.answer: RSVP means “Please respond.” We kindly ask you to respond only if you are certain you can attend, as this will help us finalize the guest list and seating arrangements. RSVP DEADLINE: JUNE 1, 2027 Please visit the RSVP page for more details and complete the form. Click here to view.

page_faq_data.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
page_faq_data.answer: <strong>No plus-ones. With limited seating, we’re keeping our celebration intimate and surrounded by close family and friends who are personally known to us. Thank you for understanding and being part of our special day.

page_faq_data.question: Can I bring my children?
page_faq_data.answer: We love children, but due to limited seating, guests should be <strong>18 years old and above. Younger guests may attend if they are part of the wedding entourage or are close family of the bride and groom, with prior approval from us.

page_faq_data.question: Can I take photos and videos during the wedding?
page_faq_data.answer:
We have a <strong>professional photography and videography team capturing our special moments. You’re welcome to take your own photos and videos throughout the celebration—just please <strong>avoid blocking their shots or the view of other guests.
We’d love to see your behind-the-scenes photos and candid moments! Please visit our <strong>Candid page and upload your photos. <a href="/candid">Click here to view.

page_faq_data.question: Do you have a gift registry?
page_faq_data.answer: For those who wish to bless us with a gift, we would be truly grateful. Please visit the <strong>Gift page for more details. <a href="/gift">Click here to view.

page_faq_data.question: What happens if it rains?
page_faq_data.answer:
We’re hoping for a beautiful sunny day, but <strong>rain or shine, we’ll be celebrating together! Both the ceremony and reception will be held indoors.
Since July is part of the rainy season, please <strong>bring an umbrella and allow extra travel time.

page_faq_data.question: What if I have more questions?
page_faq_data.answer: If you have any questions not covered in our FAQ, please feel free to <strong>reach out to us directly. We’ll be happy to help!
